- Overestimate prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast values.
- Underestimate prices in the late part of the forecast horizon; increase final forecast values to align with mean reversion toward historical levels.
- Overshoot after sharp upward spikes; cap forecast values at 10–15% below the peak to avoid overreaction.
- Model tends to overreact to recent volatility; dampen forecast sensitivity to short-term price swings.
- Forecast mean is consistently higher than true mean; apply a downward bias correction proportional to recent volatility.
- For periods with low historical variance, forecast should be closer to historical mean; avoid overfitting to recent outliers.
